## Blocks

| Block | Friendly label | C++ form | Help | Fields | Inputs |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `func.define` (definition) | `define %NAME with … returns %RETURNS` | `%RETURNS %NAME(…) { … }` | Defines a function: a named group of blocks you can use again. | `NAME`: the name of the new function. `RETURNS`: a type, `void`, `int`, `double`, `bool`, `char` or `std::string`, default `void`. | `BODY`: blocks. Setting `params`: up to 16 parameters, each `int`, `double`, `bool`, `char` or `std::string`. |
| `func.return` (statement) | `return %VALUE` | `return %VALUE;` | Leaves the function, giving back a value if the function returns one. | — | `VALUE`: any value; optional. |
| `func.call` (reporter, gives the type of `FUNC`) | `%FUNC %ARG …` | `%FUNC(%ARG, …)` | Calls a function and uses its result. | `FUNC`: the function it uses. | `ARG0`, `ARG1`, …: any value, one for each of `argCount`; required. Setting `argCount`: 0 to 16, default 0. |
| `func.call_stmt` (statement) | `%FUNC %ARG …` | `%FUNC(%ARG, …);` | Calls a function. | `FUNC`: the function it uses. | `ARG0`, `ARG1`, …: any value, one for each of `argCount`; required. Setting `argCount`: 0 to 16, default 0. |
